Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `29c86ca4488fde6427398c549784a699feaf5eda`
Local-runs: probe — the seat ran, in a detached read-only worktree of the head (no edit, no network write): `node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test` → ✓ 216 cases / 13 batteries, `execute.mjs --self-test` → ✓ 208 / 20, `dispatch.mjs --self-test` → ✓ 265 / 24, `rerun-failed.mjs --self-test` ✓, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` → rest-channel.md 80 / 80 ✓, `check-skill-id-lint.mjs` ✓ 105; the new op was NOT exercised against the live repository by the seat or the dev (the dev's two ablations — POST→PUT on the add verb, `/sub_issue`→`/sub_issues` on the remove path — each turned the batteries red and were restored hash-proven)
Scope: scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs (header section, `FIELDS.sub_issue`, the two `OPS` rows with `distinct`, `SUB_ISSUE_FENCES`, the pure judges and texts), scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs (`readSubIssues`, `subIssuePreflight`, `confirmSubIssue`, the main-loop wiring, the window constants, battery floor 19 → 20), scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs (the `distinct` rule, the roster rows, battery floor 12 → 13), scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs (the seat-side battery, floor 23 → 24) + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md (governed prose: the write-side row and the paid line; cited home `reading-discipline.md` L35 read on the head)

The claim 6485756839 served `TIER_DEFAULT` (no path mandate); this review is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` because `rest-channel.md` is governed rules text.

### ① Derived judgments

- The two `OPS` rows: `sub_issue_add` → one `POST /repos/{repo}/issues/{parent}/sub_issues`, `sub_issue_remove` → one `DELETE /repos/{repo}/issues/{parent}/sub_issue` (the platform's singular path); required `issue` + `sub_issue` (both `int`, `distinct`), nothing optional, permission `issues`, never `alone`, no second repo, no `body` in the payload — the executor sends `{ sub_issue_id }` from the child's own GET. Pinned by validate's battery (23 rows). Matches the card's 「Reader」 (number in, id resolved by the executor) and triage's 「closed table … not a general REST passthrough」. Holds.
- Fences judged by the executor on its own reads immediately before the write (`subIssuePreflight`): parent and child each answer as an issue on the stroke's repo (pull or transferred card refused by name, integer `id` required); `free` for add — the child's `GET …/parent` answers 404 or THIS parent (a child under another parent is refused; under this parent ⇒ measured no-op, nothing sent); `listed` for remove — the parent's whole list (paged ×100, cap 10 pages, a truncated list is a SUBSET and fails) lists the child's id. An unread fact fails its fence. `replace_parent` is never sent (a move is remove + add, two named actions; the packer refuses the key). Holds — the fence set is the right shape for an irreversible hierarchy write.
- Landing = read-back: the parent's list re-read inside a 30 s window at 3 s polls lists / no longer lists the child's id; a 2xx that never settles is FAILED UNCONFIRMED with 「⛔ do not re-send」; a no-op whose two reads disagree is FAILED naming both reads. Holds.
- The relay's permission model: `issues: write` is the literal grant on every stroke (fleet-write.yml L119) ⇒ no `alone`, no scoped mint, no workflow line — the card's one STOP condition did not trigger. Holds.
- Seat side (dispatch.mjs): links pack beside other issue ops in ONE stroke; a self-link, a `sub_issue_id` or `replace_parent` is refused at the packer; neither row is a body / run / content-creating / annotated op, so pacing is rule ①'s gap and nothing is read back at the seat (the executor's confirmation is the landing, as `pr_update_branch`); a failed run is exit 5 after one dispatch, never re-sent. Holds.
- `rest-channel.md`: new row 「挂子卡走中继 op `sub_issue_add`/`sub_issue_remove`(`issue` 父号,`sub_issue` 子号),回读父列表。」 (112 B) paid by deleting 「本表只指路,⛔ 不在两处各存一份;先问 git,再问 REST。」 — its read-order half lives at `reading-discipline.md` L35 「读序 git、payload、REST、MCP;…通道对照见 rest-channel.md」 (read on the head) and the pointer to `platform-readings.md` stays on the line above. 80 / 80. Holds.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: PM tooling + protocol prose, no package; `skip-changeset` correct; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial, matching the claim.

### ③ Boundary flags

- NOT MEASURED by the seat: the live behaviour of the two endpoints (the dev read `GET …/parent` → 404 「No parent issue found」 and `GET …/sub_issues` on #27293 read-only; the write was never sent). The first live stroke is the seat's act after landing — proposed: re-link nothing; the next epic split uses the op, and its read-back row is the measurement.
- Dev's deviations accepted: the model-free commit trailers (AGENTS.md); the gate batch that hit the runner's 580 s timeout was re-run alone (exit 0); the formula/lint prerequisite build; read-only live GETs for the parent-endpoint fact. The dev's card comment 6486345352 miscounts `api_writes` as 3 (it is 2 relay dispatches + git push) — corrected here, not re-posted.
- Battery floors raised 12 → 13, 19 → 20, 23 → 24 with the pins read off the floor's own refusal text — the pattern the `run_rerun_failed` comment at `execute.mjs` L1050 documents. `check:self-test-wired` green (dev); the three fleet-write self-tests are already wired in `package.json` L95–97.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; `api_writes` 2 (both relay); draft, no flip by anyone; five commits (one wip, one docs, one merge) — history on the dev's own branch, no force.
- Platform fact worth a line in the record and nowhere else: an issue with no parent OMITS `parent_issue_url` while `GET …/parent` answers 404 — the add fence reads the endpoint for exactly that reason (dev's note; the seat agrees it is a fact, not a defect).

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the maintainer's words (「有很多子卡,这是没有挂到子任务,你应该处理。」 → 「中继不支持也应该立卡」) and the fleet invariant (the write side is always `objectstack-fleet[bot]`): a cloud epic PM now links its children through the closed table under the fleet identity, so the epic queue read and the half-state patrol see the subtree and no person's login appears on the hierarchy again. Against the four-axis frame: AI-error (four fences on the executor's own reads, a measured read-back, refusal of the move flag — structurally hard to misuse), long-run (two rows in the existing table, the existing confirmation pattern, one prose row), focus (no passthrough, no workflow change, no new gate). Holds. Residual: the live measurement waits for the first epic split.

## 维护者速读 — 席位终稿 · PR #27360 · head `29c86ca4` · `domain:skills#2` · 2026-10-29T02:48Z

- 改了什么:fleet-write 中继的封闭 op 表新增 `sub_issue_add` / `sub_issue_remove`:席位只报父卡号与子卡号,执行器自己读子卡取 REST id、在写前自读四道围栏(父子都是本仓 issue 而非 PR/已转移卡;add 时子卡无父或已是本父;remove 时父卡列表确有此子),发一次 `POST …/sub_issues` 或 `DELETE …/sub_issue`,再回读父卡子列表(30 秒窗口)确认落地;子卡已挂本父 ⇒ 零写 no-op;⛔ 永不发 `replace_parent`(移动 = remove + add 两个动作)。只花 `issues: write`(每笔都有),不改 workflow。`rest-channel.md` 加一行写侧表、同文件付账(80/80)。自测 193→216 / 188→208 / 260→265。
- 为什么改:你的原话「有很多子卡,这是没有挂到子任务,你应该处理。」「中继不支持也应该立卡」—— #27293 的 10 条子卡挂接是 `sunhaolin` 个人账号直写的,违反「写侧恒为 objectstack-fleet[bot]」;云席位没有直连 mint,只能走中继。
- 风险与回滚:只改 PM 工具脚本与一行协议文本,不碰产品包;新 op 未对真仓试跑(dev 两条消融腿证明自测会抓到动词/路径写错);回滚 = revert 本 PR。首次真实使用在下一次 epic 拆卡时,其读回行即实测。
- 先看:`ops.mjs` 的 `SUB_ISSUE_FENCES` 与头注〈The two rows that write an issue's hierarchy〉;`execute.mjs` 的 `subIssuePreflight` / `confirmSubIssue`;`validate.mjs` 的 `distinct` 规则。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test` 三个 exit 0;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` rest-channel.md 80/80。
- 需要你做的:无 —— Tier S(一条 `.claude` 路径 + `scripts/pm/**`),契约复核 PASS(6486410767)后席位按你今天的落地授权落地。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。围栏在执行器自读上判、读回实测、no-op 零写、拒 `replace_parent`,四轴里的防错轴与聚焦轴都站得住;席位复跑三套自测全绿;dev 在卡上报告把 `api_writes` 数成 3(实为 2 次中继 + git push),本记录更正。
